Looking at this question about the paper "Super-multiplex vibrational imaging" (Nature, 2017), I need to identify the purification method used for a residue during the synthesis of MARS2209.

MARS2209 is one of the SERS (Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering) tags described in this paper by Min et al. The synthesis of these Raman-active tags involves multi-step organic chemistry. In the supplementary methods of this paper, the purification of residues (intermediate compounds) during the synthesis of these tags typically employed silica gel flash chromatography, which is the standard workhorse purification technique for organic intermediates in this type of synthesis.

[ANSWER]E[/ANSWER]
